title: Sight Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Sight-specific static attributes defining optical characteristics, stabilization, zoom range, and tracking capabilities.

basic_durability.description: Basic durability, subsystem is disabled when it drops to 0 and restored when repaired to 30%.

pass_damage.description: Whether to pass damage to the subsystem holder.

limit_damage.description: Whether to limit the damage transfer value to the remaining durability.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the subsystem in the HUD display.

vertical_stabilized.description: Whether vertical stabilization is enabled (compensates for vehicle pitch).

horizontal_stabilized.description: Whether horizontal stabilization is enabled (compensates for vehicle yaw).

base_fov.description: Base field of view in degrees, i.e., the FOV at 1x zoom.

base_zoom.description: Minimum zoom multiplier (default 1.0, i.e., base FOV).

min_pitch.description: Minimum pitch angle limit in degrees, positive = looking up, negative = looking down.

max_pitch.description: Maximum pitch angle limit in degrees.

yaw_limit.description: Yaw angle span limit in degrees, the actual range is [center - limit/2, center + limit/2].

hud_components.description: List of sight HUD component resource locations, pointing to GuiAnimatable definitions under hud/.

tracking_target_inputs.description: List of tracking target input channels.

discovery_inputs.description: List of sight discovery handshake channels (ordered by priority).

allow_cycle.description: Whether to allow this sight to appear in the F5 camera cycle.

on_destroyed.description: Sound event when the sight is destroyed.

on_activate.description: Sound event when the sight is activated.

on_deactivate.description: Sound event when the sight is deactivated.

sounds.description: Basic sound configuration for the sight.
